'''Drengineer''' was a company whose products existed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Drengineer products included [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and other personal equipment such as [[Armor/Legends|chestguards]] and cuirasses.
